source._toolchain_note: Go 1.27.3, upstream's own line (stack owner 2026-10-28): go.mod at v1.3.1 says `go 1.27.2` (upstream's Dockerfile builds with golang:1.27.2-alpine3.23), so this is the one stack component not on the stack's Go 1.26.10. The go directive stays exactly as upstream wrote it: it also sets the module's GODEBUG defaults, so lowering it would change runtime behaviour against upstream's binary. golang:1.27.3-bookworm is the 1.27 line's latest patch, the twin of 1.26.10 (BASE_IMAGE_DIGESTS.lock).

binaries_from_source.name: kube-vip
binaries_from_source._note: Upstream Makefile: LDFLAGS=-ldflags "-s -w -X=main.Version=$(VERSION) -X=main.Build=$(BUILD) -extldflags -static" with VERSION := v1.3.1 and BUILD = `git rev-parse HEAD` (the full commit), `go build $(LDFLAGS) -o kube-vip` from the repo root, CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux (Dockerfile). `kube-vip version` prints `Version:  v1.3.1` and `Build:    <commit>`. Upstream's image puts the binary at /kube-vip and its ENTRYPOINT is ["/kube-vip"]; the generated pod manifest passes args ["manager"].
